epic.title: Parent Finance & Fee Payment Module
epic.body: Provides parents with a comprehensive financial dashboard to monitor fee structures, track payment history, view outstanding balances, and securely process fee payments for multiple children.

features.title: Fee Monitoring & Ledger
features.body: Enables parents to view detailed fee breakdowns, installment schedules, and real-time payment status for each child.

stories.title: Student Fee Summary Interface
stories.body: Display a high-level summary of total fees, amount paid, and remaining balance for the selected child on the parent dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Display summary cards for 'Total Fees', 'Paid Amount', and 'Balance Due'.
Show a visual progress bar indicating the percentage of fees paid.
Include a 'Next Due Date' indicator for upcoming installments.
Update data dynamically when switching between children profiles.

stories.title: Detailed Fee Breakdown & Installment List
stories.body: As a parent, I want to see a detailed list of fee heads and installment plans so I understand the cost breakdown.
acceptanceCriteria: List all fee components (e.g., Tuition Fee, Transport Fee, Lab Fee).
Display installment timeline showing due dates, amounts, and specific status (Paid/Pending/Overdue).
Differentiate between 'Mandatory' and 'Optional' fee heads as defined in the structure.

stories.title: Parent-Child Fee Retrieval Service
stories.body: API endpoints to serve fee structures and transaction history for children associated with the parent.
acceptanceCriteria: GET: Retrieve the assigned fee structure for a specific studentId.
GET: List all processed transactions and receipts for the student.
Security: Restrict data access to authorized parent accounts only.

features.title: Payment Processing & Receipts
features.body: Functionality for parents to make secure online payments and download official payment receipts.

stories.title: Online Payment Workflow
stories.body: Interface to initiate payments for selected installments or custom amounts using various payment modes.
acceptanceCriteria: Enable selection of specific installments for payment.
Display a summary of the selected amount and applicable convenience fees.
Provide a 'Pay Now' action that triggers the payment gateway integration.
Show success/failure notifications post-transaction.

stories.title: Receipt Viewing & Download
stories.body: As a parent, I want to list and download receipts for all completed payments for my records.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Show a history of successful transactions with receipt numbers (e.g., REC-12345).
Download: Action to generate and download a PDF receipt for any 'Paid' transaction.
Metadata: Display payment mode (UPI, Card, Cash) and transaction reference IDs.

stories.title: Transaction & Receipt Generation Engine
stories.body: Backend logic to process payments, update student balances, and generate unique receipt records.
acceptanceCriteria: POST: Create a transaction record and update the student ledger status.
Logic: Auto-calculate remaining balance and update installment status from 'Pending' to 'Paid'.
PDF Service: Generate a secure, tamper-proof PDF receipt containing institute branding and student details.
